text:
Italy coach Roberto Mancini admits he ‘immediately’ regretted leaving the Azzurri in 2023: ‘I should have flown to Roma and cleared things up with the president.’
Italy coach Mancini released an interview with Corriere dello Sport discussing, among other things, why he left the job in August 2023, weeks before being appointed coach of the Saudi Arabia national team.
Mancini insisted he hadn’t yet signed his contract with Saudi Arabia before leaving the Azzurri.
“No, I hadn’t done it—I hadn’t. At the root of it all was a lack of communication between President Gravina and me.”
The CT explained how his relationship with ex-FIGC President Gabriele Gravina fell apart.
“I thought he intended to replace me at the first sign of trouble,” Mancini said.
“We’d been talking about the staff for months, and I kept brushing it aside, pretending nothing was wrong. Meanwhile, the weeks went by, and the issues remained unresolved. We picked up the conversation again after the Nations League in the Netherlands, but didn’t reach any conclusions. Then there was a month of silence.
“Honestly, I didn’t want to leave. I would have liked to stay; leaving wasn’t my intention,” Mancini continued.
“But sometimes things happen. I think I made a mistake, especially in how I judged certain issues that needed addressing. If we’d dealt with them, probably none of this would have happened.
“I should have got on a plane, flown to Rome, and cleared things up with the president.”
When did he realise that leaving Italy had been a mistake?
“Immediately. But by then, I couldn’t turn back,” he said.
“If Luca [Vialli] had been there, we would have talked, and we would have resolved a lot of things.”
Mancini returned for a second stint as the Azzurri coach last summer.
Initially, Paolo Maldini and his advisor, Leonardo, had picked Andrea Pirlo as the Azzurri boss, but when the deal fell through, new FIGC President Giovanni Malagò took matters into his own hands and appointed Mancini, leading to Maldini and Leonardo’s resignation.
“The same happened the first time, too,” Mancini recalled.
“I wasn’t the designated head coach. Carlo [Ancelotti] was. They turned to me when he chose something else.”
Mancini won three of his first six games in charge of Italy in his second spell, with the Azzurri finishing third in their Nations League group.
digest_he:
רוברטו מאנצ'יני התראיין לתקשורת ושיתף בפרטים מאחורי עזיבתופוקדת נבחרת איטליה באוגוסט 2023, זמן קצר לפני שמונה למאמן נבחרת סעודיה. מאנצ'יני הבהיר כי טרם חתם על חוזהו בסעודיה בעת שעזב, וכי שורש הבעיה טמון בחוסר תקשורת מול נשיא ההתאחדות גבריאלה גראבינה והחשש שלו מפני פיטורים אפשריים.

לדברי המאמן, הוא הבין מיד שעזיבתו הייתה טעות אך לא היה יכול לחזור בו באותו שלב. הוא ציין כי אם לוקה ויאלי היה לצדו, דברים רבים היו נפתרים אחרת. מאנצ'יני שב בהמשך לקדנציה שנייה כמאמן הנבחרת לאחר תהפוכות שונות בהנהגת הכדורגל האיטלקי.
